verdicts.flaw_description: The measured population does not match the exposed one: "Rates cover every patient admitted to each ward" while "a quarter of each ward's patients had spells outside the protocol", so a quarter of the patients generating the 6-11 percent drop were not continuously under the handwashing protocol.

A named alternative cause reaches every plot: "Prey abundance on the surrounding farmland doubled from the previous year" and "every box stood at the farmland edge, within the birds' foraging range", so the extra 9-16 fledglings at Hollowmere could be the doubled food supply rather than the boxes.

Exposure is far narrower than measurement: "Readings cover every enrolled user in each cohort" but only "a fifth of each cohort used the app on some nights", so the 3-6 bpm cohort-wide drop is averaged over users who mostly never used the app.

The pass rates are a selected subgroup, not the cohort: they "cover the students who attended every block" while "about a quarter of each cohort missed at least one block", so the 4-8 point gain compares full attenders against a whole previous cohort and could be attendance selection rather than the tutoring.
